items.title: ORIGIN 1.0
items.text: A media center for your addons, on LG webOS and Google TV: your library, the best stream in one press, and subtitles that stay in sync.

items.title: A source fails, the next one plays
items.text: When a source does not play, the next best one starts by itself, then a third. If all three fail you choose from them.

items.title: Sound on every device
items.text: On Google TV the app carries its own decoders for Dolby, DTS and TrueHD: older boxes without them play every film with sound.

items.title: Clean sources, the right episode
items.text: Fake files and sources of another episode are left out, and a torrent pack plays the episode you opened.
